name: Quebec Maple Butter
where: Maple specialty stalls at Marché Jean-Talon
about: A spread made from 100% maple syrup, a sweet and smooth treat that reflects Quebec's long maple tradition.
tip: Check the storage instructions before opening, since they can vary by product.

name: Montreal Bagel
about: A bagel made by the traditional Montreal method, a local favorite known for its slightly sweet, dense style.
tip: Buy close to your departure or eat within a short time, as bagels go stale quickly.
